mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate used in equity valuation models, compressing discount rates and increasing present values of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market that supports corporate hiring, wage growth, and consumer spending, leading to stronger earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 650 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, a key component of consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior 3-month levels.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100.0) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a robust labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100.0 and UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 220.0), the central bank pursues aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0.
